rationale.StaticFieldLeak: SystemUiHooks retains the process application context for observers and configuration reads. ScreenshotClipboardHooks only receives the android-package context from system_server; its setting observers and verified configuration writes share that process lifetime, and no Activity context reaches this field.
rationale.DrawAllocation: Existing preview matrix and lazily cached pair clip allocation remain bounded; require a measured regression before changing rendering.
rationale.ExportedContentProvider: Cross-process access is intentional; the provider authenticates every call and file open. Caller policy and generation behavior have regression coverage.
